description: Na₄Sr₂TiP₄ is alpha Pu-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Ti and five P atoms. The Na-Ti bond length is 3.27 Å. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 3.06-3.36 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four P atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.87-3.22 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four P atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.18 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four P atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.23 Å. There are two inequivalent Sr sites. In the first Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five P atoms. There are a spread of Sr-P bond distances ranging from 3.09-3.23 Å. In the second Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five P atoms. There are a spread of Sr-P bond distances ranging from 3.05-3.30 Å. Ti is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to one Na and four P atoms. There are a spread of Ti-P bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.45 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to five Na, two equivalent Sr, and one Ti atom. In the second P site, P is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na, two Sr, and one Ti atom. In the third P site, P is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to four Na, three Sr, and one Ti atom. In the fourth P site, P is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to four Na, three Sr, and one Ti atom.
